mechanism_narrative: The current federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) of 3.64% is historically associated with positive equity returns, leading to positive 20-day forward S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS is at 3.64%.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 330, it indicates high inflation, which typically leads to monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL > 330, the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI (CPIAUCSL) is above 3.0 and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 3.5%, it indicates a 'sticky inflation' regime where the central bank is slow to tighten, leading to positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL > 3.0 and FEDFUNDS < 3.5, the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 5.0%, it indicates a weak labor market that often precedes economic slowdowns, leading to negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: When UNRATE > 5.0, the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1200.0 thousand units, it indicates a weak housing market, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: When HOUST < 1200.0, the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100.0, it indicates a weak manufacturing sector, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: When INDPRO < 100.0, the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: When residential fixed investment (RSAFS) is below 700,000 million dollars and industrial production (INDPRO) is below 100.0, it indicates a simultaneous weakness in housing and manufacturing, leading to negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
regime_hint: dual weakness in housing and manufacturing
failure_condition: When RSAFS < 700000 and INDPRO < 100.0, the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: When the number of employees (PAYEMS) exceeds 158,000 thousand, it indicates a strong labor market, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: When PAYEMS > 158000, the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of cases.
